title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 40
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 40: Jeremiah released from his chains, Gedaliah made governor at Mizpah, and the warning Gedaliah would not believe.

questions.text: From where had Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard let Jeremiah go?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's word came to Jeremiah after Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, where he had taken him bound in chains among the captives.

answers.text: From Mizpah
From Ramah
From Riblah
From Tahpanhes

questions.text: What reason did the captain of the guard give Jeremiah for this evil coming on the place?
questions.explanation: The captain of the guard said that Yahweh had brought it and done as he spoke, because they had sinned against Yahweh and had not obeyed his voice.

answers.text: Because the king had burned a scroll
Because the prophets had lied to the people
Because the city would not pay tribute
Because they had sinned and not obeyed Yahweh's voice

questions.text: What choice did the captain of the guard put before Jeremiah when he released him from his chains?
questions.explanation: He released Jeremiah from the chains and said that if it seemed good to him he could come with him to Babylon, and if not, all the land was before him to go where it seemed good and right.

answers.text: To come with him to Babylon, or to go wherever seemed good to him
To stay in prison, or to serve the king of Babylon
To go to Egypt, or to remain at Ramah in chains
To take a present, or to take a field in Anathoth

questions.text: What did the captain of the guard give Jeremiah when he let him go?
questions.explanation: The captain of the guard gave Jeremiah food and a present, and let him go.

answers.text: A field and a vineyard
A deed and witnesses
Food and a present
Chains and a guard of thirty men

questions.text: Whom had the king of Babylon made governor over the cities of Judah?
questions.explanation: The captain of the guard told Jeremiah to go back to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the cities of Judah.

answers.text: Johanan the son of Kareah
Gedaliah the son of Ahikam
Ishmael the son of Nethaniah
Baruch the son of Neriah

questions.text: Where did Jeremiah go to live with Gedaliah among the people who were left in the land?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah went to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah, and lived with him among the people who were left in the land.

answers.text: To Bethlehem
To Anathoth
To Gibeon
To Mizpah

questions.text: What did Gedaliah swear to the captains of the forces and to their men?
questions.explanation: Gedaliah swore to them not to be afraid to serve the Chaldeans, but to dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it would be well with them.

answers.text: Not to be afraid to serve the Chaldeans, but to dwell in the land
To go down into Egypt together with him
To fight against the army of the Chaldeans
To bring their offerings to Yahweh's house

questions.text: What did Gedaliah tell them to gather and put in their vessels?
questions.explanation: Gedaliah told them to gather wine and summer fruits and oil, put them in their vessels, and dwell in the cities they had taken.

answers.text: Silver and gold and fine linen
Wheat and barley and honey
Wine and summer fruits and oil
Water and bread for the siege

questions.text: Who, according to Johanan, had sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take Gedaliah's life?
questions.explanation: Johanan and the captains told Gedaliah that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon had sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take his life.

answers.text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon
Baalis the king of the children of Ammon
Pharaoh the king of Egypt
The king of Moab and the king of Edom

questions.text: How did Gedaliah answer Johanan's offer to go and kill Ishmael secretly?
questions.explanation: Gedaliah told Johanan not to do this thing, because he was speaking falsely of Ishmael.

answers.text: He forbade it, saying Johanan spoke falsely of Ishmael
He sent Johanan out that same night
He asked Jeremiah to pray about it first
He agreed, but told him to let no one know
